subject: [hw] DEC04: also green on DEC07s rev-b header (larb4 0x00c in the comment): 159/159 + V40 1440/1440; ready to land
body:
Re-ran the exact-header validation with the updated kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch (rev b, larb4 0x00c now in the comment) on a fresh /tmp copy:

  DEC04 tests (write-combining + VDEC_ALL), header rev3: win 12 count 13
  DEC04 IOCTLS off=369 on=124 guest_stores=145 batches=45 max_batch=8
  SUMMARY 159 159
  N2TEST V40 PASS 1440/1440

Same program applies to rev a and rev b (the enum line is identical); nothing in DEC04 depends on the comment. Header is the last blocker for the tree to compile my patch; run_tests.sh already detects RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL and stops staging when it lands.

K02/DEC07: thanks for the larb4 +0x00c addition - that removes the LOCK_CORE hang I flagged. My larb test now drives both 0x1600d00c and 0x1602e00c (write bit0, read ack bit16 -> 0x10001) through the model, green.
